Review the ESCParty GitHub Project board and propose a cleanup plan.

## Inputs to use
- Project board link provided by the user
- Any keep/remove rules the user specifies
- Short-term plan in plans/plan-escparty.md
- Long-term roadmap in plans/roadmap.md

## Steps
1. Open the board view and capture the columns and visible items.
2. Identify outdated, duplicate, or unclear items and list them as candidates to archive or rewrite.
3. Map remaining items to the short-term plan and long-term roadmap.
4. Propose a refreshed backlog structure with 3-5 near-term priorities.
5. Ask for confirmation before making any edits on the board.

## Output Format
Project Board Snapshot:
- ...

Cleanup Candidates:
- ...

Proposed Backlog Refresh:
- ...

Questions for Project Lead:
- ...
